item.title: Do You Need a Filter and Pressure Reducer for Patio Drip Kits?
item.description: Method note: This guide is built for patio and balcony growers who keep hearing that every drip setup needs a filter and pressure reducer but are not sure what problem those parts actually solve. Disclosure: This guide contains affiliate links. We earn a commission if you purchase through these links — at no extra cost to you. See affiliate disclosure for details. Short answer: usually yes for faucet-fed patio drip kits, and often “it depends” for reservoir-fed systems.
